entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the Velo-Pro jersey I bought. I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for it, but it's the wrong size. It's just... way too tight and I can't even ride in it.
I understand how frustrating it is when the fit isn't quite right. Let me see what we can do. Can I get your order number, please?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I just feel so bad, I really needed this to work out.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. The jersey was delivered about 35 days ago. That's perfectly fine. Our policy for standard items like this allows for returns within 10 days.
Oh, really? So I can still return it? That's a huge relief. I was worried I was stuck with it. Would it be possible to do an exchange for a larger size?

Absolutely. An exchange is no problem at all. I can get that started for you right now. I've just processed it and you should receive an email with a pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Once we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the new one immediately.
Wow, that's fantastic! Thank you so much, Isaac. You've really turned my day around.
It's my pleasure. We want to make sure you have gear that you love. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
